answer: Each identity claims one reef haven site, locks a 70-credit bond on its serial, and pays a doubling fee: the first 100 pay 30, the next 100 pay 60, doubling per block, so the 1000th pays 15,360 and 1,000 fakes pay 3,069,000 plus 70,000 locked. A comet beacon publishes the registry total each epoch for an auditor to recompute every fee from the reef haven registry, burning bonds for underpayment or reused serials. A rented-site ring fails because each receipt is keyed to payer and serial, so a second filing burns both bonds. Honest identities pay 30 once and reclaim bonds after a clean epoch.
